project_type: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo: React+Vite frontend (S3+CloudFront), AWS Lambda+API Gateway v2 backend, DynamoDB save data, Amazon Bedrock conversational AI, AWS CDK IaC. A Digimon-style monster raising web game (Japanese UI). Kiro University Challenge submission.
build_system: npm workspaces monorepo. Packages: packages/shared (@ddm/shared), packages/backend (@ddm/backend), packages/frontend (@ddm/frontend, Vite+React), infra (CDK app, workspace name 'infra'). Root scripts: build (shared->backend->frontend->infra), test (shared node:test), synth (cd infra && npx cdk synth), deploy (cd infra && npx cdk deploy --all).
